business_problem: faced the challenge of expanding its units due to the low data visibility offered by its decentralized technology platforms With the support of Qualiserve and SND Distribuição, the franchisor unified its processes using three Microsoft solutions: Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Power Platform and Microsoft 365.
solution_summary: Mania de Churrasco! used Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Azure Synapse Analytics to replace disconnected manual workflows with a more consistent digital operating model. Low-code automation and copilot capabilities orchestrate tasks, route work, and surface context to agents or business users without requiring separate point solutions. Where generative AI is involved, Azure OpenAI handles the language understanding layer while connected data and workflow services keep responses grounded in enterprise context. It also connects with surrounding systems such as SharePoint, which lets the new Azure-based workflow fit into existing operations rather than standing apart from them. achieved high efficiency, security and scalability in its operations, in addition to improving its data intelligence, which indirectly participated in a 20% increase in sales year on year.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Fabric
solution_components.role: Unifies lake, warehouse, analytics, and BI workloads on a single managed data platform.

solution_components.name: Power BI
solution_components.role: Delivers dashboards, reports, and self-service analytics to business users.

solution_components.name: Azure Synapse Analytics
solution_components.role: Runs integrated SQL and big-data analytics across enterprise datasets.

solution_components.name: Azure OpenAI Service
solution_components.role: Runs large language model inference for summarization, extraction, conversational AI, and grounded answers.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
solution_components.role: Builds conversational agents and copilots with enterprise integrations and controls.

data_flow: Content and operational context are prepared in the application data layer, passed to Azure OpenAI for generation or extraction, stored in Azure storage services, and returned through Microsoft Copilot Studio to employees or customers with grounded responses.
business_outcome: achieved high efficiency, security and scalability in its operations, in addition to improving its data intelligence, which indirectly participated in a 20% increase in sales year on year.
